# iosxe_crypto_map_gdoi (Data Source)

This data source can read the Crypto Map GDOI configuration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "iosxe_crypto_map_gdoi" "example" {
  name            = "GETVPN-MAP"
  sequence_number = 10
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Crypto map name
- `sequence_number` (Number) Crypto map sequence number

### Optional

- `device` (String) A device name from the provider configuration.

### Read-Only

- `gdoi` (Boolean) Configure GDOI map type
- `id` (String) The path of the retrieved object.
- `set_group` (String) Set the GDOI or GKM group for this crypto map
